name: Bug evidence plan writer
why: Ranks suspects with a check for each before anything changes, the same order as the device fault diagnosis skill.

name: Fix a bug with proof and a clear pull request
why: Proves the cause, makes the smallest fix and opens a pull request, which is how firmware fixes reach the repo at level 2.

name: Write docs a new developer can follow on day one
why: Turns a project into a README and a first-run test, a fuller version of the wiring guide prompt for larger firmware repos.

name: Weekly dependency and security sweep
why: Tracks new versions and security fixes week by week, useful for keeping cores, SDKs and libraries inside their support periods.

name: Test failure repair loop
why: Works through failing host-side tests in capped rounds, for firmware projects that unit-test their logic off the board.

name: Turn an incident into a safer procedure
why: Writes the blameless report and prevention actions after a bad update or a fleet outage.

name: Embedded Firmware Engineer agent
why: Plans tasks, pin maps, memory limits and failure handling for ESP32, STM32 or Nordic chips, a second view for larger RTOS projects.

name: IoT Fleet Engineer agent
why: Plans fleet updates with test stages, rollback and health checks, matching the staged firmware rollout workflow.

name: Firmware update recovery rehearsal
why: Rehearses update failures and recovery before a gated rollout, the readiness step before customer waves.

name: Check a circuit and its evidence
why: Checks part limits with worst-case sums and keeps predicted and measured results apart, for wiring that goes beyond a simple pin table.
